name: Obrenor: The Outcast Prince
source:
You play as the youngest prince of a wealthy kingdom, who must defy the odds to protect his people from mysterious threats. You'll make friends, encounter enemies, and maybe even find love along the way.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/LazyTigerStudio]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一个富饶王国最年幼的王子，必须冲破重重困难，保护人民免受神秘威胁。一路上，你会结交朋友、遭遇敌人，也许还能找到爱情。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/LazyTigerStudio]Patreon[/url]]
